title: The Consecrated Manifold
logline: A shipyard chapel guards a decommissioned drive manifold as a sacred memorial to a dead hero, but an overworked engineer needs the heat-resistant alloy to save the station cooling grid.

roles.description: Presides over the orbital shipyard shrine; fiercely defends the memorialized manifold against secular scavengers.
Chief repair engineer for the orbital slipways; watches heat monitors spike while hunting for scrap radiators.
An apprentice drive technician whose parent died during the historic reactor scram; torn between family honor and station safety.
A scorched heavy beryllium-cuprite thruster manifold bolted to the chapel altar under brass litany plaques.
A cavernous repair berth whose upper gantry houses the memorial chapel overlooking the slipway heat sinks.

public_situation: Dockers in {system} visit a shipyard memorial chapel where a charred drive manifold honors a mechanic who died preventing a reactor meltdown.
private_truth: The revered martyr caused the fatal core blow-out while attempting to siphon radioactive fuel, and {role:chapel_preacher} consecrated the wreckage to save the family's pension.

beats.public_change: Alarms sound across {role:sanctified_drydock} as primary coolant radiators overheat under peak shipyard load.

missions.reason: The engineer needs cuprite ore delivered immediately to cast emergency heat sink fins before core temperatures breach safety tolerances.
missions.private_fact: He knows ore casting will take days and intends to use the delay to justify confiscating the heat-rated manifold from the chapel.

beats.public_change: The engineer brings plasma torches to the memorial chapel, but shipyard laborers form a defensive ring around the shrine.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to run an acoustic resonance scan on the manifold to prove cutting into it will rupture pressurized internal coolant tubes.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice found their parent's private log chip and fears the station telemetry will prove the martyr was fleeing rather than repairing.

player_choice.prompt: The acoustic scan decodes the manifold core: the revered martyr caused the explosion during a fuel theft, and the preacher faked the heroic consecration.

options.label: Give the proof to the engineer to authorize cutting down the manifold and saving the drydock
Help the apprentice machine a scrap bronze shell to preserve the shrine while the engineer takes the heat coils
Hand the telemetry to the preacher to destroy, leaving the memorial intact at the cost of emergency power cuts

beats.public_change: Thermal alarms echo across the slipway as secondary coolant loops begin venting vapor into the bay.

missions.reason: The engineer needs the salvaged manifold heat exchanger transferred from the upper gantry into the coolant manifold bay before pumps seize.
missions.private_fact: He promises to log the component as unidentified surplus to keep the truth from spreading across the union halls.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reveals the truth and installs the salvaged manifold exchanger.
resolutions.summary: {role:yard_engineer} dismantles the shrine and cools the docks, but the fuel theft is exposed, stripping {role:novice_mechanic}'s family pension.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a dead shipyard hero's final crime to strip their altar for cooling coils.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot and apprentice replace the manifold with a bronze shell.
resolutions.summary: The cooling grid is saved with the salvaged coils while a replica manifold sits in the chapel. {role:chapel_preacher} keeps the faith alive.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot quietly patched a shipyard's failing grid without letting the chapel altar burn.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the telemetry to the preacher to preserve the memorial.
resolutions.summary: {role:chapel_preacher} seals the records and preserves the martyr's shrine. The yard shuts down half its drydocks to prevent meltdown, racking up debt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or yard security breaches the chapel during runaway.
resolutions.summary: Yard crews cut apart the manifold during an emergency scram, destroying the telemetry. {role:sanctified_drydock} survives under heavy damage fines.

loose_threads.detail: The manifold serial plate shows the factory stamp was ground away and re-stamped with a forge mark belonging to a rival shipyard.
A lien notice on the chapel alcove shows its sanctuary lease was purchased by an anonymous offshore debt trust six months before the accident.

radio_hooks: Thermal alarms at {role:sanctified_drydock} prompt heated disputes over chapel altar preservation.
{role:yard_engineer} demands emergency salvage access to historic shipyard shrines.
Pilgrims hold candlelit vigil along gantry rails as reactor core temperatures stabilize.

voice_direction.chapel_preacher: Reverent, unhurried, treating industrial machinery as sacred vessels and speaking in measured, liturgical cadences.
voice_direction.yard_engineer: Harried, abrasive, speaking in fast bursts of technical jargon with zero patience for religious ceremony.
voice_direction.novice_mechanic: Quiet, hesitant, speaking with guarded reverence about family history while nervously double-checking heat gauges.
